mapper.select: SELECT transfer_id, transfer_number, transfer_type, transfer_status, amount, memo, spending_category, completed_at, created_at FROM wallet_transfers WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT transfer_id, initiator_member_id, transfer_number, transfer_type, transfer_status, amount, memo, spending_category, completed_at, created_at, idempotency_key FROM wallet_transfers WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_transfers (currency_code, initiator_member_id, transfer_number, transfer_type, transfer_status, amount, memo, spending_category, completed_at, idempotency_key) VALUES ('KRW', #{initiatorMemberId}, #{transferNumber}, #{transferType}, #{transferStatus}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{spendingCategory}, #{completedAt}, #{idempotencyKey})
